Jachin Samuel J
Kanyakumari, India | jachinsamuel007@gmail.com | +91 99440 01925
LinkedIn  |  GitHub  |  Portfolio
Professional Summary
Second-year Computer Science & Engineering student who has independently designed, built, and deployed three production fullstack
applications (React, Flask, PostgreSQL), published an open-source Python package to PyPI, and contributed merged pull requests to
microsoft/vscode. Currently a Software Development Intern at a logistics startup. Seeking a Software Engineering internship to apply
full-stack development, API integration, and problem-solving skills to real-world systems.
Experience
Software Development Intern — HoldMate (Logistics Startup)
July 2026 – Present
●
Secured the role through direct outreach on LinkedIn, managing the full professional communication flow from initial contact
through formal onboarding with the Operations team.
●
Building and shipping UI components and pages in React for HoldMate's production platform, collaborating with the engineering
team through code review and Git-based workflows.
Education
B.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering
2025 – 2029 (Expected)
Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore   CGPA: 8.93
Projects
Nexus RAG — Cognitive Engine & Semantic Explorer  Python · FastAPI · SQLite-VSS · Docker · Multi-Provider LLM APIs
GitHub
●
Architected a production-grade, local-first Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform with hybrid semantic vector search,
long-term memory extraction, and a multi-provider LLM router (NVIDIA NIM, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama).
●
Engineered a hybrid retrieval pipeline combining cosine-similarity embeddings (SQLite-VSS) with BM25 keyword fallback,
improving context relevancy while reducing search latency.
●
Designed a background memory process that extracts user preferences and developer-specific facts from chat history, storing them
as embeddings to enable persistent, personalized agent recall across sessions.
●
Solved recurring context-overflow (HTTP 400) failures by implementing a sliding-window token-budgeting algorithm, eliminating
crashes with zero added latency.
FoodyBuddy — Full-Stack Canteen Ordering Platform  React · Flask · PostgreSQL · Razorpay · Twilio WhatsApp API
GitHub   Live Demo
●
Designed and deployed an end-to-end canteen ordering platform used by real students, replacing manual, phone-based ordering with
online payments and live order tracking.
●
Integrated Razorpay for secure checkout and Twilio for automated WhatsApp order notifications, removing the need for manual
status calls.
●
Built admin tooling — receipt download, one-click reorder, and audio alerts — to speed up staff workflow during peak hours.
Ace — AI-Powered Git Copilot (Published on PyPI)  Python · Git · Ollama · NVIDIA NIM · OpenAI · Anthropic Claude API
GitHub   PyPI Package
●
Built and published ace-git-copilot, an installable CLI/TUI tool translating natural-language intent into Git commands — publicly
installable via pip.
●
Integrated local (Ollama) and cloud LLM APIs (NVIDIA NIM, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude) to automate code review, PR drafting,
and commit message generation.
Open-Source Contributions

microsoft/vscode — Merged PR fixing a duplicate enum entry in the VS Code source.
●
